1. [Sexy Cosplay Doll](https://mangadex.org/title/aa6c76f7-5f5f-46b6-a800-911145f81b9b/sono-bisque-doll-wa-koi-wo-suru)

We occasionally scanlate random My Dress-Up Darling doujinshi (SFW only), [clips from](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YmEvfBF_UkM) [the radio show](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y3uh8vGKqvM), and anything else we feel like doing, like [a VN-style video for a bonus Drama CD](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kvNa0_HB9EQ) or [a two chapter oneshot with a Marin-clone](https://mangadex.org/title/abad18cf-bf72-4bbc-97c8-b55dfa28f9b9/the-cutest-girl-closest-to-me).

We will not work on any Viz simulpubbed series because we want to avoid any C&D, we want to support the official release, and we find it's a waste of resources when we can work on other series. attributes.name: Laid Back
attributes.description:
Welcome to Laid Back! 
We are a scalation group that started on November 18, 2021. We are focused on the best translation and scan results. You can support us by donating or joining our discord, thank you

attributes.name: Sho Habby Scans
attributes.description:
## "So called scan group"
We're a small scanlation group dedicated to delivering high quality scans with fully redrawn SFX (within reason). We hope you like our work! We're open to picking up more series given we can find staff to provide consistent uploads for them. Come hang out with us in our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/GdV76sQs7d)!

Current series (in pickup order):
- [Josee to Tora to Sakana-tachi (Josee, the Tiger and the Fish)](https://mangadex.org/title/c8c7de84-4ad7-4712-9800-549314c8e6c6)
- [Kaette Kudasai, Akutsu-san! (Please Go Home, Akutsu-san!)](https://mangadex.org/title/737a846b-2e67-4d63-9f7e-f54b3beebac4)
- [Kono Kaisha ni Suki na Hito ga Imasu (I Have a Crush at Work)](https://mangadex.org/title/3e8cf40f-ba17-480a-b60b-a675db032ee2)
- [Horimiya](https://mangadex.org/title/a25e46ec-30f7-4db6-89df-cacbc1d9a900) (Vol. 17 w/ [iltrof](https://mangadex.org/group/aaa9c59b-dec8-4c65-bfd8-27fe6ff7402d) & [TSP](https://mangadex.org/group/4d41149e-0ec8-4846-82a2-88d112b9dffa))
- [Busu ni Hanataba wo. (April Showers Bring May Flowers)](https://mangadex.org/title/b8272d78-498e-477c-8835-548d3f2370e4)
- [Yancha Gal no Anjou-san](https://mangadex.org/title/5e3a710f-0b0d-482b-9e84-d9c91960c625)
- [Seishun Buta Yarou wa Siscon Idol wo Yume no Minai (Rascal Does Not Dream of Siscon Idol)](https://mangadex.org/title/8587c766-37a3-4fb0-89db-8145fafb3152)
- [Ogami Tsumiki to Kinichijou (Tsumiki Ogami's Not-So-Ordinary Life)](https://mangadex.org/title/df361a38-eef6-4674-bec6-86d08aa1d1aa) (Ch. 1-8 w/ [Emergency Tsumiki Comittee](https://mangadex.org/group/e62b19b7-e4a2-4119-a7c3-31b1c278ea59) & [Church of Potteto](https://mangadex.org/group/457ff7be-62ab-4552-83d8-ee3f3e1c02c1))
- [Sasayaku you ni Koi wo Utau (Whisper Me a Love Song)](https://mangadex.org/title/0e8fac17-979e-4e37-8f45-2c334b25d6dd) (SFX Only)
- [Houkago, Bokura wa Uchuu ni Madou](https://mangadex.org/title/91a2e0c9-cd81-4bf7-b5f7-bb37434bf6b3)

Other stuff we have worked on:
- [Kubo-san wa Boku (Mobu) wo Yurusanai (Kubo Won't Let Me Be Invisible) — Extras](https://mangadex.org/title/cddd1849-ab36-4304-8103-06ba4062b5e6) [completed]
- [Kubo-san wa Boku (Mobu) wo Yurusanai (Kubo Won't Let Me Be Invisible) — Oneshot](https://mangadex.org/title/a7c87cce-0825-482b-af7d-2f5867972fa2/kubo-san-wa-mob-wo-yurusanai) [oneshot]
- [Hanamaru Hoppe](https://mangadex.org/title/68b5d925-acf0-48d5-a051-c84446ce0d23) [oneshot]
- [Alice-san Chi no Iroribata](https://mangadex.org/title/0df86784-961a-443c-9765-8b41702c6249) [completed]
- [Sukinako ga Megane wo Wasureta (The Girl I Like Forgot Her Glasses) — Twitter Extras](https://mangadex.org/title/43541d36-7996-472b-aefb-72f640c29eda) [completed]
- [Hana ni Arashi (Rainbows After Storms)](https://mangadex.org/title/bc86a871-ddc5-4e42-812a-ccd38101d82e) [completed]
- [Seishun Buta Yarou wa Yumemiru Shoujo no Yume wo Minai (Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dreaming Girl)](https://mangadex.org/title/438a42fa-2fe4-45f3-9996-eea8f50c7382) [completed]
- [Atri no Hon](https://mangadex.org/title/d072a43a-4ced-4e92-b9a6-5d0b8029a3a5/atri-s-book) [oneshot]
- [Shinimodori Reijou no Lucetta (Lady Lucetta, Back from the Dead)](https://mangadex.org/title/8546848b-0c69-4e1f-b6b5-4b0b3bf0cb3d) (w/ [Shared Reads](https://mangadex.org/group/9f9f4d80-8a58-41cb-8bb3-a13426642ba5)) [dropped — web publishing]
- [Osananananajimi (We're J-Just Childhood Friends)](https://mangadex.org/title/8573d280-7f60-411d-b146-c97dca3c62f2) [dropped — simulpub]
- [Anemone wa Netsu wo Obiru (The Anemone Feels The Heat)](https://mangadex.org/title/c5d731f9-c1cf-4a69-a797-cd9c2a58316b) [complete]

attributes.name: Unknown
attributes.description:
This group serves to host scanlations whose authors are impossible to determine.

- If you do not know where a scanlation comes from, **DO NOT UPLOAD IT.**
- If a chapter doesn't have a scanlation group because it's an official translation/original/raw: **READ THE [RULES](/rules)**, those are forbidden.

In almost all cases they do not fit under this group even when allowed due to exceptions.

Unless it is literally impossible to know where a scanlation comes from, do not use this group.
If that is truly the case that it is a scanlation but the author is impossible to credit, please get in touch with the staff before uploading.

Failure to comply to these rules will get your account blocked from uploading in the future.

**If you can identify any of the chapters uploaded to this group, report them and provide evidence.**

**If you can confirm that there's no known source for these chapters, report them and they'll be moved to the Verified group.**
